activities.description: Tessa flies over a stream, scattering glowing orbs.
The Narrator stands amongst other Grove Children, looking at Tessa.
Tessa and the Narrator talk and practice fighting moves.
Tessa turns and her eyes glow red.
Tessa, possessed, stands over a fallen Grove Child.

characterInteraction.description: Tessa acts as a mother figure, both nurturing and protective. The Narrator expresses respect and admiration for Tessa.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The pulsating flower-like creature represents Unity, a force seeking to absorb all life forms.

mood.description: Starts calm and peaceful, then transitions to fear and despair.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Visual mood change when Tessa's eyes turn red.
Auditive mood change with narrator's voice becoming more serious.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduces the Grove Children and their idyllic life, foreshadowing the coming danger.
The Grove is established as the home of the Grove Children, nurtured by Mother Tessa.
The Narrator describes the Grove Children's sheltered life.
Tessa warns of lurking dangers and attempts to prepare her children.
Tessa succumbs to a mysterious influence.
A monstrous creature emerges, representing Unity.
Tessa, under Unity's control, attacks and kills a Grove Child.

props.name: Glowing orbs scattered in a stream.

scenes.thematicElements: Loss of innocence, the dangers of isolation, the power of manipulation.
scenes.title: The Grove

videoEditingDetails.description: Close-up on Tessa's face as her eyes turn red.
Shift to a darker, more ominous tone as the flower-like creature appears.

activities.description: Tessa and other Grove Children stand near a portal.
Tessa gathers the life force of her children.
Tessa screams in pain as she absorbs the life force.
The Grove Children walk towards the portal, carrying Tessa's lifeless body.

characterInteraction.description: The Narrator grieves for his fallen siblings. Tessa makes the ultimate sacrifice for her remaining children.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Tessa's sacrifice is portrayed as a necessary evil, highlighting the tragic choices forced upon them by Unity's invasion.

mood.description: Tragic and somber, marked by loss and desperation.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Auditive mood change with Tessa's scream.

narrativeProgression.description: Shows the devastating consequences of Unity's influence and the desperate measures taken to survive.
The remaining Grove Children, corrupted by Unity, turn against their brethren.
Tessa, trapped and facing the loss of her remaining children, chooses to sacrifice them to empower the uncorrupted survivors.
The survivors, carrying Tessa's lifeless body, escape through the portal.

props.name: A glowing red orb representing Tessa's life force.

scenes.title: The Sacrifice

videoEditingDetails.description: Close-up on Tessa's face as she gathers life force.
Quick cuts between Tessa's face and the portal.
Slow-motion as the Grove Children carry Tessa's body.

activities.description: A group of survivors walk through a temple, led by the Lancer and Cryomancer.
Tessa's body is carried through the portal.
Tessa revives, her eyes glowing yellow.
Unity's forces attack through the portal.

characterInteraction.description: The Lancer and Cryomancer appear to be leaders of the group. The Grovewalker displays unique abilities. The survivors work together to revive Tessa.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Tessa's revival with glowing eyes hints at a potential connection to Unity, raising questions about her allegiance and the true cost of her sacrifice.

mood.description: Tense but hopeful, filled with anticipation and a sense of impending conflict.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Visual mood change with shift from dark temple to bright portal.
Auditive mood change with hopeful tone in the music.
Visual and auditive mood change as dark creatures emerge from the portal and music becomes more intense.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduces new characters and suggests a plan to fight back against Unity.
Survivors, including representatives of different classes, gather at a temple.
The Grovewalker opens a portal, suggesting a plan for Tessa's revival.
Tessa, still lifeless, is brought through the portal, highlighting the risk involved.
Tessa is successfully revived, but with a changed appearance, suggesting lasting consequences from the sacrifice.
Unity's forces attack, confirming the ongoing threat.

props.name: A statue holding a glowing orb.
A swirling portal, similar to the previous one.
A glowing cube with green energy, held by the Grovewalker.

scenes.thematicElements: Hope, resilience, the consequences of sacrifice.
scenes.title: Hope

videoEditingDetails.description: Close-up on the portal as it appears.
Quick cuts between the survivors entering the portal and the portal itself.
Close-up on Tessa's face as she revives.

narrativeProgression.description: Serves as a call to action, encouraging viewers to engage with the upcoming game update.

videoEditingDetails.description: Static image of the Grovewalker on a green background. Text appears: 'SKYFORGE OVERGROWTH II' and 'FREE UPDATE IS COMING' 'PC - APRIL 11' 'PS4, XBOX ONE - APRIL 12'. Preorder information for the Collector's Edition.

trimmingSuggestions.description: The static image in Scene 4 could be replaced with a montage of action-packed gameplay footage from the Overgrowth II update, further enhancing the dynamism and excitement.

text_to_speech: [Music] The Grove. Our cradle. Mother Tessa made this our home. Trapped on a foreign world, Tessa kept reminding us of the dangers that lurked in the shadows. She thought she could prepare us. But when the call came. We were not ready. Hear. Listen. Obey. Open your mind. Hear the voice of unity. This world is not theirs. Rise up. Reclaim what is naturally ours. [music] The young and weak were the first to turn. We lost our brothers and sisters that day. Cornered and without a way out, Tessa was left with no choice. Mother had to take the life force of her children who were lost to his call. But it was… not enough. We made the biggest sacrifice of all. To give our siblings a chance to revitalize. To fight another day. [music] They are coming. [music]

What is Skyforge?
Allods Team & MY.GAMES are proud to present Skyforge -- a highly-stylized free-to-play AAA Sci-Fi Fantasy massively multiplayer online role-playing game featuring exciting dynamic combat inspired by console action games, set in a brand new universe of gods and heroes, who use futuristic technologies to fight off incredible creatures and protect their planet against space invasions. The strongest of the heroes will take their path from a young immortal to the Great God, ascending to the climax of glory and head the Pantheon.
